source: flow_graph/plant_flow_graph.json node EW_4 (graph revision AD); docs-authority/duties/EW_4.md sections 3, 4 and 6; docs-authority/nozzles/EW_4.csv; flow_graph/placement_seed.json; Generated by models/mfg/tracker.py (AQS-PLAN-006 section 6). Not edited by hand.

nozzles.service: anode Cl2 (+ O2 side) to leach oxidation

material: Cathode titanium Grade 2, 3 mm. Anode titanium mesh, 1.5 mm, mixed-metal-oxide coated (AQS-STD-002 section 9). Tank and racks PVC/FRP; 316L frame withdrawn (AQS-STD-002 M3). Corrosion allowance 0 mm on the titanium; hydride check per AQS-STD-002 section 9. Pit rate is not measured. Cathode annealed, no cold forming after anneal; anode protected from reverse current (AQS-REV-H2-001). Cell-to-cell transfer by free-fall launder with air break; floating DC; protection current on trip (AQS-STD-002 section 11).

design.service: electrowinning cell, Pb cathode product; chloride liquor 55 C in / cell-to-cell launder out
design.bus_pack: 1 x 20 x 6.3 mm Cu C101 per pole (AQS-BUS-001 Rev D EW-4 row)
design.basis: AQS-DUTY-051 Rev F section 1 and the row of its section 2 for this cell (the element-envelope current at CE 0.85, 2.12 V); channel DC on IA-DC-EW_4 0.13 kW with the 0.3 V bus drop.

layout.frame: origin at the envelope corner; x along 270, y along 720, z up
layout.electrodes: anodes at x 85 + 100k (2), cathodes at x 135 + 100k (1); sheets y 60..660, z 160..580; tabs 120 wide rise to z 691 (study contact arrangement, AQS-STD-002 section 9: Ti tab against the Cu bar above the liquor line)
layout.bus: pack pair over the tab line: + y 330..350, - y 370..390 (20 mm creepage gap, AQS-STD-002 section 11); bars x 135..255 on FRP pads at beam stations x 110/220; rectifier lugs at the -X bar ends
layout.nozzle_spread: the schedule gives face and height; the stations run in height order along the wall, OD-aware (wall webs survive the bores between z-overlapping bores, rounded down to 5 mm), vent bridge at x 135, recorded per tag in check.nozzles_drawn with any height clamp named
layout.vent_support: the schedule vent is face top on an open tank: two PVC-U posts on the inner walls carry a rim bridge at z 750..760; the stub hangs to its 650 datum
layout.drain: drain at the discharge-end sump (x 200), flush at z 0, boss top at the 50 datum
layout.hardware_idiom: connection hardware flush at the envelope faces (lib/nozzles.place_on_face default); nothing protrudes, bbox = size_mm
